paite: Huan Pathian in Noah leh atapate avualzawl a, akiang uah, "Chi tampi suang in hong pung unla, lei hon luahdim un.
heading: Noah Toh Pathian Thukhun
english: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.

paite: Leitung a sa chiteng leh tung a leng vasa chiteng in nou kihtakna leh lauhna anei ding uh. Hiaite leh lei a bokvak a pai tengteng leh tuipi a ngasa tengteng na khut ua piak ahita uhi.
english: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.

paite: Thil hing tang thei chitengte nou a ding in nek ding ahi ding ua; anteh hing ka hon piak bang in bangkim ka hon pe vek hi.
english: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.

paite: Himahleh sa, ahinna sisan toh zaw na nekhawm ding uh ahi kei.
english: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

paite: Na hinna sisan phu ka la ngeingei ding. Sa chiteng lak ah ka la ding a; mi lak ah leng. Michih asanggamte uh lak ah, mite hinna phu ka la chiat ding.
english: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

paite: "Mi sisan suahmi kuapeuh, huai mi mah in ama sisan asuah ding, Pathian batpih a mihing bawl ahi ngal a.
english: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

paite: "Nou chi tampi suang in hong pung unla, ta leh nau tampi nei unla, leitung ah hong pung un," achi hi.
english: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly on the earth, and multiply in it.”

paite: Pathian in Noah kiang leh akiang a om atapate kiang ah,
english: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

paite: "Ngai un, kei mahmah in na kiang uah leh na nung ua na suante uh kiang ah leng ka thukhun ka hihkip hi.
english: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

paite: Na kiang ua om thil hing chiteng, na ompih uh vasate, gante, na ompih uh lei a sa chitengte kiang ah leng; long a kipan hong pawt tengteng, lei a sa chiteng kiang nangawn ah.
english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

paite: Na kiang uah ka thukhun ka hihkip ding; sa tengteng leng tuichim a hihman in a-om nawn kei ding ua; lei hihse ding in tuichim atung nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

paite: Pathian mah in, "Kei leh nou leh na kiang ua thil hing chiteng omte kal a, suan tawp nei lou a omte a ding in, hiai ka thukhun chiamtehna ahi ding hi.
english: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

paite: Meipi ah ka sakhituihup ka zamsak a, huai kei leh lei kal a thukhun chiamtehna ding ahi.
english: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, leitung a meipi ka kaisak in meipi ah sakhituihup akimu ding hi.
english: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

paite: Kei leh nou leh sa tengteng lak a thil hing chitengte kal a, ka thukhun om ka theigige ding. Sa tengteng hihmang ding in tui alet nawn kei ding hi.
english: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

paite: Meipi a sakhituihup azam chiang in, Pathian leh leitung a sa om tengteng lak a thil hing chiteng kal a tangtawn thukhun om ka theihgige theihna ding in ka en zel ding," achi hi.
english: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

paite: Pathian mah in Noah kiang ah, "Hiai kei leh leitung a sa om tengteng kal a ka thukhun hihkip chiamtehna ahi," achi nawn hi.
english: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

paite: Noah tapa long a kipan pawtte Shem, Ham leh Japheth ahi uhi (Kanaan pa Ham ahi).
heading: Noah Leh Atapate
english: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

paite: Hiai mi thumte Noah tapate ahi ua, amaute a kipan pawtte'n leitung pumpi azelsuak uhi.
english: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.

paite: Louneimi in Noah ahong om pan a, grephuan abawl hi.
english: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

paite: Uain adawn a, akham a; apuanin ah alumkhialta hi.
english: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

paite: Kanaan pa Ham in apa lumkhial amu a, inpua a om a-unau nihte ava hilh hi.
english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

paite: Shem leh Japheth in puan ala ua, aliang ua kizawn in anung pai ua, apa uh lumkhial ava khuh uhi. Amai uh lehlam nga in apa uh lumkhial amu kei uhi.
english: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

paite: Noah, uain kham ahong halh a, atung a atapa naupangpen in ahihdan ahon theita hi.
english: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

paite: "Kanaan hamsiat in om hen. Asanggamte sikhate sikha ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”

paite: "Shem TOUPA Pathian phat in om hen. Asikha in Kanaan om hen.
english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.

paite: Pathian in Japheth hihlian henla, Asikha in Kanaan om hen,” achi lai hi.
english: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”

paite: Tuichim tun nung in Noah kum zathum-le-sawmnga adam hi.
english: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

paite: Noah damsung tengteng kum zakua-le-sawmnga ahi a; huchi in asita hi.
english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.
